Window Cleaning in Sudbury, Ontario

Sudbury Workforce offers window cleaning in Sudbury, Ontario for homes, storefronts and offices. We clean windows inside and outside, with screens, tracks and sills included, on houses up to two storeys. Outside windows are cleaned only when it's above freezing.

Window Cleaning Questions

Do you clean windows inside and outside?

Yes, both sides of every window.

Do you clean outside windows in winter?

Not in freezing weather. We clean outside windows when it's above freezing.

Are screens, tracks and sills included?

Yes, they're part of every window we clean.

How tall a house can you do?

Houses up to two storeys.

How do I get an estimate?

Text or WhatsApp a photo of your windows to 705-562-9047, email sudburyworkforce@gmail.com, or fill out the form below. We'll send a free, no-obligation estimate.

Do you cover my area?

We clean windows all over Greater Sudbury, from Downtown and Minnow Lake to Val Caron, Azilda and Coniston. See all the areas we serve.
